title: HMGN2 induces pyroptosis in tumour cells by modulating the STT3B/PD‑L1/caspase‑1/GSDMD axis.
authors: Han, Wenwen; Chen, Hongli; Cui, Bomiao; Chen, Jiao; Zhang, Ping; Feng, Yun
one_liner_zh: 该文研究HMGN2蛋白与肿瘤细胞膜受体STT3B结合并诱导焦亡的机制，虽涉及蛋白-DNA结合蛋白和AlphaFold3/ZDOCK对接，但核心是蛋白-蛋白互作而非TF-DNA结合，方法应用浅层，与课题关联有限。
abstract: High‑mobility group nucleosomal‑binding domain 2 (HMGN2) is an abundant conserved protein that acts as a non‑histone nuclear DNA‑binding protein. HMGN2 can be released by activated peripheral blood mononuclear cells, CD8+ T cells and gammadelta T cells, and can induce tumour cell apoptosis. In the present study, receptors of HMGN2 were detected on tumour cell membranes and the mechanism by which HMGN2 induces tumour cell apoptosis was examined. Flow cytometry was used to determine the degree of HMGN2‑induced apoptosis. To identify notable HMGN2 receptors on tumour cells, the present study used immunoprecipitation and mass spectrometry (IP/MS) to identify protein complexes. Western blotting and immunofluorescence were used to confirm interactions between HMGN2 and oligosaccharyltransferase subunit STT3B (STT3B), and to elucidate the downstream regulatory mechanism of HMGN2. The predictive tools ZDOCK and AlphaFold3 were used to determine the binding conformation of HMGN2 to STT3B. HMGN2 was shown to bind to the membrane and induce the apoptosis of CAL‑27 tumour cells. STT3B was identified via IP/MS as a receptor of HMGN2 on the CAL‑27 membrane and subsequently identified as an important receptor of HMGN2 via an anti‑STT3B blocking assay. ZDOCK and AlphaFold3 analyses revealed that HMGN2 and STT3B formed a stable protein docking model. After incubation with HMGN2, the expression of programmed cell death 1 ligand 1 (PD‑L1)/caspase‑1/gasdermin D (GSDMD) axis components was significantly increased, and PD‑L1 was translocated into the nucleus from the membrane of CAL‑27 cells. The results of the present study indicated that extracellular HMGN2 induced pyroptosis in tumour cells by modulating the STT3B/PD‑L1/caspase‑1/GSDMD axis.
abstract_zh: 高迁移率族核小体结合域2（HMGN2）是一种丰富且保守的蛋白质，作为非组蛋白核DNA结合蛋白发挥作用。HMGN2可由活化的外周血单核细胞、CD8+ T细胞和γδ T细胞释放，并能诱导肿瘤细胞凋亡。在本研究中，检测了肿瘤细胞膜上的HMGN2受体，并探讨了HMGN2诱导肿瘤细胞凋亡的机制。使用流式细胞术测定HMGN2诱导凋亡的程度。为识别肿瘤细胞上显著的HMGN2受体，本研究采用免疫沉淀和质谱法（IP/MS）鉴定蛋白质复合物。使用蛋白质印迹和免疫荧光法确认HMGN2与寡糖转移酶亚基STT3B（STT3B）之间的相互作用，并阐明HMGN2的下游调控机制。使用预测工具ZDOCK和AlphaFold3确定HMGN2与STT3B的结合构象。结果显示，HMGN2与膜结合并诱导CAL‑27肿瘤细胞凋亡。通过IP/MS鉴定STT3B为CAL‑27膜上HMGN2的受体，随后通过抗STT3B阻断实验确认其为HMGN2的重要受体。ZDOCK和AlphaFold3分析揭示HMGN2与STT3B形成稳定的蛋白质对接模型。与HMGN2孵育后，程序性细胞死亡配体1（PD‑L1）/caspase‑1/gasdermin D（GSDMD）轴组分的表达显著增加，且PD‑L1从CAL‑27细胞膜转位至细胞核。本研究结果表明，细胞外HMGN2通过调节STT3B/PD‑L1/caspase‑1/GSDMD轴诱导肿瘤细胞焦亡。
